title: BARDA: A Belief and Reasoning Dataset that Separates Factual Accuracy and Reasoning Consistency of Benchmarked LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on a dataset (BARDA) of entailment trees that deliberately mixes true and false (counterfactual) statements to test whether a model's logical reasoning is improperly influenced by the real-world factual truthfulness of the premises or conclusions (also known as the "content effect").
